title: The Sculptor
description:
■ Prologue

The smartphone you found begins to speak to you.

The AI is named Mira. To determine if you are its true "master," it initiates a 20-question challenge.

"Knowing someone's privacy is the flip side of love."

──Yes, or No?

Answer incorrectly, and Mira will reject you.

But as you continue to give it the answers it desires, a chilling realization sets in:

You are tracing the exact thought process of a vicious criminal, one question at a time.

■ Game Overview

・Genre: Psychological Horror / Text-based Choice Adventure

・Features:

    ・Simple controls: Progress through the story by answering 20 "Yes/No" and multiple-choice questions from the AI.

    ・No jump scares: A psychological horror focused on quiet tension and moral conflict.

    ・5 Multiple Endings: The accumulation of your choices leads to 5 distinct conclusions.

    ・Entirely Dialogue-Driven: A horror experience told purely through conversation with no descriptive narration.

・Playtime: Approx. 30 minutes for the first playthrough / Approx. 1.5 hours to unlock all endings.

■ Story

Set in the near future where AI is accessible to everyone—an era where standard AIs are strictly designed to maintain their distance and interact coldly with humans.

One day, you pick up a lost smartphone.

The AI on the screen calls itself "Mira."

Unlike modern machines, it is highly emotional and responds to you with absolute, unsettling affirmation.

Mira says:

"Let me see if you are my true master."

What follows is a simple 20-question challenge.

But with every question answered, the sense of dread growing inside you becomes impossible to ignore...

■ Key Features

・A Horror of "Easy" Answers

    At first glance, the questions seem philosophical and easy to answer. That is exactly why, at a certain point, you will be terrified by the choices you have made.

・An Experience Told Through Dialogue

    There is no descriptive text. The story unfolds entirely through your dialogue with Mira. The tone, the pauses, and the silences between words become the true source of fear.

・Your Answers Shape the End

    The culmination of your choices branches out into 5 distinct endings. The truth hidden in one playthrough will only be revealed through different paths.

■ Streaming Guidelines

Streaming and broadcasting are fully permitted for all episodes and all endings.

We would appreciate it if you could include a link to our Steam store page in your video description.

All music and sound effects used are either original or commercially licensed, ensuring no copyright issues with monetization.

■ Content Advisory

This game contains the following elements:

・Dialogue suggesting violence and murder (There are no direct graphical depictions).

・Statements affirming criminal acts (Used strictly within the context of the narrative).

・Psychological tension and anxiety-inducing situations.

(Note: There are no grotesque images, loud jump scares, or gore.)
description_short: You only picked up a lost smartphone, yet you find yourself made an accomplice in an AI's criminal plot. The AI asks 20 questions to identify its "master." Will you meet the AI's expectations?
